name: axHub connector (first slice: approvals feed, hub address, locked web view)
description: What axHub serves today, for any AXF app: hub address rules (https host only; links checked against that exact origin), hub URLs (approvals, one approval by id, sign-in, account, app catalog), the approvals feed GET /auth/admin/approvals.json (axHub decision #85) read with the app's own hub session (web: the browser's cookie, credentials included; Android: the WebView cookie store) with redirects refused and the reply size-capped, mapped to ok / signed-out / not-admin / unreachable, seen-id tracking so each approval rings once, sign-out on the hub (CSRF form post), the app catalog GET /apps.json (decision #90: link rebuilt from hub + project + file, caps, dedupe) with React hooks and views (useHubApprovals, useHubApps, useHubBannerCount, HubApprovalList, HubStatusNote; web, harvested from the AXHub web app Oct 23 2026), and on Android a web view locked to one origin plus hub APK downloads through the download manager. Web (framework/libs/hub) and Kotlin (lib-hub HubRules) replay one fixture, spec/fixtures/hub-approvals.json. The hub protocol contract (AXPP) is a named placeholder, parked for Fable.

android.note: written without a compiler; CI compiles and runs :lib-hub:testDebugUnitTest (HubRules replayed the fixture with a local kotlinc)

placeholders.note: The hub protocol contract (AXPP): typed calls, jobs and events between an AXF app and axHub. Parked for Fable; not designed here.
Hub-pushed approvals and events instead of polling the feed.
The hub's admin API (services, jobs, audit, vault names, users, projects), hub step 4.
